description: This Java class 'AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' extends 'AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' and wraps an existing logger to automatically discard MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries after each log operation. It provides various logging methods (error, warning, info, debug) and MDC management functionalities, ensuring MDC cleanup after each log message.

classes.name: AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A final class that wraps an 'AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' to automatically discard MDC entries after log operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of 'AutoDiscardingDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' by wrapping an existing 'AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter'.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError (with Throwable)
methods.description: Logs an error message along with an exception cause.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as an immutable Scala Map.

methods.name: mdc (setter)
methods.description: Overwrites the current MDC with the provided Scala Map.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as a Java Map.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets the MDC with a given Java Map.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
